review: A charge based rupture ID. His clashes on s2 is average but s3 can reach above average if the conditions are fulfilled. Without a certain charge count he is count negative although once the conditions are fulfilled which for s2 is 10 charge and s3 with 15 charge he inflicts 3 potency with count neutral and 11 potency with 2 count positive respectively. He also gets haste every 5 charge which allows him to inflict count first before everybody else procs it. Another thing to note is that once he uses s3 the benefits mentioned above also disappears as his charge count is lower now. But that is where the EGO Dimension shredder shines as it allows him to gain 4 charges passively and makes all of his skills count neutral without condition, Of course you need to have higher speed but with yi sang’s passive and speed range this is not a problem Notable E.G.O Synergies: Dimensional Shredder - Mak
